messages:
Maya: Dropped a new prototype for the Usage & Billing panel in Figma — includes a compact "Spend Insights" tile, an Org / Project switch, token breakdown toggle, and a tiny invoice preview. PTAL: https://figma.com/proto/sample123. Quick question: should the dashboard default to Org scope or remember last used scope per user?
Rahul: My vote: default to Org for billing admins but remember last-used per user as a preference. Admins should also be able to pin Org as default in account settings.
Linh: Frontend note: stacked bar per month is cheaper to animate and easier for tooltip hit-testing than stacked area. If we overlay the legend inside the chart, we need to ensure it doesn't cover bars on narrow screens.
Oscar: On token buckets: we can show Prompt/Completion/Embedding/Rerank. Important: the UI labels must exactly match what's in billing export to avoid reconciliation questions. I'll prepare a mapping doc.
Priya: UX rule: avoid more than two primary controls in the card header. Suggest: Scope [Org | Project] and Granularity [Monthly | Daily], then a "Details" dropdown for full token types + invoices.
Gabe: Finance requirement: CSV must include invoice_id, billing_account_id, project_id, date, tokens, cost_usd. Also the invoice preview must display invoice number, date, and a "View invoice" link.
Maya: Proposed copy tweak: change card title from "Estimated spend" to "Estimated billed spend (USD)" and tooltip text: "Based on recorded usage and pricing; final charges shown on invoices." Thoughts?
Linh: Accessibility flag: current Figma palette uses low-contrast shades for the legend. a11y-bot, can you run a contrast scan for small legend text and colorblind simulations?
a11y-bot: Scan results: mid-blue #3F7AD9 fails AA for normal text; darken to #2B5FB0 or add textures/patterns for fills. Also recommend keyboard-focusable chart elements and aria-live for tooltip content.
Oscar: For colorblind-safe options I can add pattern fills and a high-contrast color set toggle in settings. Will attach example svgs to the figma comments.
Priya: Microcopy: under CSV export add: "Exported figures are estimates until invoices are finalized." Keep it subtle.
Gabe: Also include a reconciliation export button that returns raw invoice mappings for a date range. Example CSV header we want:
```invoice_id,billing_account_id,project_id,date,tokens,cost_usd
```
Rahul: Rollout plan: behind `spend_insights_v2` flag. Start with 5% of orgs, enable admin opt-in in console to preview. We'll monitor dashboard vs invoice variance and error rates.
Maya: Good. On the legend placement debate: prefer inline legend overlay on wide screens, sidebar on narrow. Would like a sticky legend when scrolling long time ranges.
Linh: Implementing sticky legend is fine. We'll need the CSS/JS hooks to reflow legend between overlay and sidebar. Also need a11y announcements when legend layout changes.
Gabe: +1 for sticky legend. Also request a quick "Export invoice mapping" action next to the CSV export for finance teams.
Maya: I'll update frames: stacked bar default, compact two-control header, invoice preview with link, and adjusted copy. Will add Figma comments for pattern fills.
Rahul: I'll make the feature flag ticket and include acceptance criteria: CSV headers, invoice link behavior, a11y checklist, and rollout percentages.
Maya: Thanks all — will iterate and ping for final handoff. :thumbsup:
